label: Lower coolant hose clip corrosion causing coolant leak
symptom: Coolant leaks from the front of the car, potentially leading to a complete loss of coolant.
cause: Plastic clip at the radiator connection corrodes and loosens, breaking the seal.
fix: Replace the OEM clip with a jubilee clip, tightened carefully to avoid damaging the plastic radiator neck.
inspection_advice: Inspect the lower radiator hose connection for corrosion or dampness.

label: Plastic intercooler cold pipe failure causing turbo loss
symptom: Sudden loss of all turbo boost, making the car undriveable, and may trigger an engine warning light.
cause: Poorly designed multi-piece welded plastic pipe weakens under heat and pressure.
fix: Replace the OEM plastic pipe with an aftermarket all-metal replacement pipe.
warning_signs: Hissing or whistling from engine bay
inspection_advice: Visually inspect the plastic intercooler pipe for cracks or splits.
